_readme: HoloVerse music. Each area plays its own track, looping the whole file.
All tracks live in assets/audio/regions/. To use your own music: overwrite a file with your MP3
(keep the same name), or point "file" at a new file. MP3, OGG and WAV all work.
A missing file means that area is silent; it never falls back to another area's song.
volume: 0.0 - 1.0 (on top of the Master / Music sliders in Settings).
tracks: HoloVerse's own areas. dimensions: dimensions HoloVerse plays a track for while they are
open (HoloCore). Any other dimension (the Indigo Giant, Vector Wars, ...) keeps its own soundtrack.

hub.area: FLAT region: the MatrixCore hub, the title screen and the flat land around the hub
